description: Header file defining classes and functions for managing Dispmanx display resources, rectangles, and video frames on Raspberry Pi, including display initialization, resource handling, and rendering.

classes.name: DispmanxRect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle for Dispmanx operations, with constructors to initialize rectangle dimensions.

classes.name: DispmanxDisplay
classes.description: Manages a Dispmanx display, handling initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: DispmanxResource
classes.description: Base class for Dispmanx image resources, managing resource handle and dimensions.

classes.name: DispmanxYUV420Resource
classes.description: Derived class for YUV420 image resources, with methods to write data and clear with black.

classes.name: DispmanxRGB565Resource
classes.description: Derived class for RGB565 image resources, with methods to write data and clear with black.

classes.name: DispmanxElement
classes.description: Represents a Dispmanx element, allowing source changes.

classes.name: DispmanxVideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame with associated Dispmanx resource and release callback.

classes.name: DispmanxVideoRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of video frames onto a Dispmanx display, including updating, hiding, and showing elements.

methods.name: DispmanxRect
methods.description: Default constructor and parameterized constructor to initialize rectangle dimensions.

methods.name: DispmanxDisplay
methods.description: Constructor initializes display; destructor closes display and deinitializes host.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Returns the handle to the Dispmanx display.

methods.name: DispmanxResource
methods.description: Constructor initializes resource; destructor deletes resource if handle is valid.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the resource (implementation not shown).

methods.name: ClearWithBlack
methods.description: Clears the resource with black color (implementation not shown).

methods.name: DispmanxElement
methods.description: Constructor creates a Dispmanx element; destructor handles cleanup; allows changing source.

methods.name: DispmanxVideoFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializes video frame with resource and callback; destructor calls release callback.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the renderer with a new video frame.
